description: Bedrock Agent lacks an explicit guardrail configuration
rationale: The agent detail is verified, no guardrail is attached directly, and the configured enforced guardrail list was read successfully and is empty. Per-request protections and other controls remain unverified; this finding is a review candidate, not proof of unfiltered inference.
remediation: Evaluate the agent's threat model, configure an appropriate Bedrock Guardrail or enforce it in validated runtime paths, and test prompt-injection/PII protections on deployed aliases.
